digest.component_or_area: container plan-review attestation and drift-scope inheritance
propositions: A live child with declared-none scope must be neutral in drift-scope inheritance: it contributes no paths and does not poison sibling path declarations or force whole-HEAD invalidation

Container all-none classification and dependency hashing must treat live undeclared children as poisoners while treating live none children as neutral, and must not synthesize all-none when no live children exist

Plan-review signing, cheap resign, and P9 linting must share the same tri-state scope precedence rule: own/cited/inherited paths yield paths, else explicit parent none yields none, else all-live-children-none promotes undeclared parent to none, else unscoped
P9 must pass declared-none leaves and containers with all-declared live children, advise only live undeclared children as poisoners, and offer both path declaration and --none as truthful remedies
Cheap resign must sign the same child-derived dependency scope as normal signing without network reads, using immutable relation snapshot child state as input
